units.text: Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python reads and writes PDF documents, converts them to other formats such as .csv, .htm, .html, .jpeg, .jpg, .json, .md, .png, .svg, .tif, .tiff, .xfdf, and .zip, and extracts tables, text, and other content. It supports encryption and decryption, font embedding, PDF/A validation, and low-code operations via the Converter class. The library operates on .pdf input and produces output in the listed formats, enabling round-trip processing through bytes or streams.

Create new PDFs from scratch or load existing ones from files, bytes, or streams, then add pages of any size, draw paths and shapes, place text with full Unicode and font control, and save the result as a complete PDF document.
Extract text from entire documents or specific regions, skip artifacts like headers and footers, and use clipping or exclusion zones to focus on the content of interest.
Detect and extract tables from pages, convert them to CSV or list structures, and author new tables with headers, rows, column spans, and per-cell styling, placing them directly onto pages.
Rasterize pages to PNG, TIFF, or JPEG with configurable DPI and color mode, export them as SVG with selectable text, create contact sheets of thumbnails, and split spreads into individual pages.
Add, edit, and export annotations and form fields, import and export review comments in JSON or XFDF, generate bookmarks from headings or text patterns, and flatten forms into static content.

Apply and remove password-based encryption using AES-256 or other standard algorithms, validate PDF/A and PDF/UA compliance, and sanitize documents to remove metadata, scripts, actions, and attachments.
List fonts used in a document, check which ones are embedded, and embed missing fonts from system sources to ensure consistent rendering and PDF/A conformance.
Process multiple files in batch using low-code wrappers for common operations such as converting to various formats, encrypting or decrypting, and merging or splitting documents.
Create a new PDF document with an A4 page and add centered text to it, then save the file as hello.pdf.
Open an existing PDF, resize its first page to A4 landscape, and apply a 28-point trim margin before saving the result as resized.pdf.

The Aspose.PDF FOSS for Python package provides core PDF manipulation through the Document class, which manages pages, forms, annotations, and structural editing, alongside specialized extractors and editors for text, images, attachments, and file-level operations.

The Document class serves as the central entry point, supporting document creation, loading from files or bytes, page management with add_page, and saving to files or bytes, while exposing properties such as page_count, version, info, and pages for structural access.

The Page class represents individual PDF pages, offering methods to add text and images, draw paths, rectangles, and lines, render the page or save it as an image, and access its size, media_box, crop_box, and annotations.

The Annotation class provides access to individual annotations via rect, contents, title, author, subtype, and properties, while AnnotationCollection supports adding annotations, converting to a list, and exporting to JSON.

The Form class manages interactive form fields, exposing fields for inspection, filling, validating, flattening, and exporting or importing JSON, as well as exporting and importing schemas for template reuse.
The PdfExtractor class extracts text, images, and file attachments from PDFs, supporting binding to a PDF, iterating through pages and images, and retrieving attachment names and content.

The PdfFileEditor class provides file-level editing operations such as concatenating, extracting, inserting, deleting, and appending PDF files, with boolean-returning methods and a last_exception property for error reporting.

The lowcode.Converter module offers high-level operations for converting images to PDF, converting to PDF/A, rotating pages, stamping content, and flattening forms, each paired with dedicated options classes.
The PdfAConverter class converts documents to PDF/A conformance levels using PdfAConvertOptions to control the conversion process and output.
The Rotator class rotates PDF pages using RotateOptions to specify rotation angle and target pages.
The Stamper class adds text, image, or page-number stamps to PDF pages using StampOptions to control appearance and placement.
The FormFlattener class flattens interactive form fields into static content, removing interactivity and embedding field values directly into the page content.
It adds full format conversion to and from Word, Excel, HTML, and image formats, certification-grade PDF/A and PDF/UA validation, and commercial support.
CaretAnnotation class represents a caret annotation with a frame and symbol property.
DocumentFont class holds information about a font used in a document, including whether it is composite and the one-based page numbers where it appears.
ExtractedTable class represents a table extracted from a PDF document, providing column and row counts, and methods to save or convert its content to CSV or a list.
FontSubstitutionOptions class provides options for font substitution, including font directories, font programs, system font usage, and platform font indexing.
FormValidationIssue class represents an issue found during form validation.
GraphicsPath class provides methods to build a path by adding circles, curves, lines, and other shapes, with properties to track the current point and path state.
OptimizationOptions class provides options for PDF optimization and a method to convert its settings to a dictionary.
PDF3DLightingScheme enum lists the lighting schemes for 3D annotations, including CUSTOM, DARK, GRAY, HEADLAMP, and WHITE.
PDF3DRenderMode enum lists the render modes for 3D annotations, including SOLID, TRANSPARENT, and WIREFRAME.
Decoder class provides a method to decode CCITT-encoded data.
PdfArray class represents a PDF array object and provides a method to append elements.
PdfBoolean class represents a PDF boolean object.
PdfDictionary class represents a PDF dictionary object and provides methods to get and pop entries.
PdfIndirectReference class represents a PDF indirect reference object.
PdfName class represents a PDF name object and raises TypeError on initialization under certain conditions.
PdfNumber class represents a PDF number object and raises TypeError on initialization under certain conditions.
PdfString class represents a PDF string object and raises TypeError on initialization under certain conditions.
Encoding class provides encoding methods and lists the LATIN1, UTF16, UTF8, and WIN_ANSI encoding values.
EncodingType enum lists the encoding types MAC_EXPERT, MAC_ROMAN, PDF_DOC, UNICODE, and WIN_ANSI.
FilterType enum lists the filter types CCITT_FAX_DECODE, DCT_DECODE, FLATE_DECODE, JBIG2_DECODE, JPX_DECODE, LZW_DECODE, and NONE.
PdfNull class represents a PDF null object.
PdfObjectID class represents a PDF object identifier.
PdfObjectRegistry class manages PDF object registration and provides methods to get and register objects.
PdfTrailerable class provides a method to get the trailer dictionary of a PDF document.
Heading class represents a heading in a PDF document.
Matrix class provides methods to multiply and translate matrices.
RevocationResult class represents the result of a revocation check.
RichRun class represents a run of rich text in a PDF document.
Revision class represents a signature revision in a PDF document.
StrokeRun class represents a run of stroke in a PDF document.
LayerConfiguration class represents a layer configuration with properties for creator, index, default status, locks, name, and shows.
StructureTypeStandard enum lists the standard structure types DIV, DOCUMENT, P, PART, RB, RP, RT, SECT, SPAN, TABLE, TD, and TH.
PdfAConvertOptions class provides options for converting a document to PDF/A format.
PdfAConverter class provides a method to process PDF/A conversion.
PdfConsts class provides methods to convert between decimal and octal representations, raising ValueError under certain conditions.
Duplex enum lists the duplex printing options DUPLEX, NONE, SIMPLEX, and TUMBLE.
PrintRange enum lists the print range options ALL_PAGES, PAGE_RANGE, SELECTION, and SOME_PAGES.
PrinterSettings class provides settings for printing a PDF document.
CompromiseCheckResult class provides a property to indicate whether a document has been compromised.
Margin class represents the margin for SVG rendering.
PageInfo class holds the bounding box and page index for an SVG page.
SvgLoadOptions class configures SVG loading with a conversion engine setting and a read-only page info property.
TaggedContext class provides the context for creating and managing tagged PDF content.
